results.name: the microphone is opened with the real WebRTC processing constraints, and the track reports them applied
the voice gate really runs on the audio thread and silences a signal below its threshold
the colour and light chain changes the rendered frame, not just a label
a canvas-backed window really is a live video source
the shell never takes a service-worker update without being asked
choosing a file opens the real platform picker rather than an in-page imitation
every control of a window is reachable by keyboard alone, with no focus trap
